name: Yumemi
source:
A full-time hostess. A bit of an enigma. Mood-driven and somewhat self-centered.

Despite her ambiguous age, she maintains the persona of a “princess from a fairy-tale kingdom.”

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=794214&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
